subject: Request: EU-region keystore residency and extended debug log retention
messages:
From: Marta Vela <marta@novamed.eu>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamed Security Team <security@novamed.eu>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: EU keystore residency + 180d debug log retention

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this — Novamed is evaluating Redwood Private for a pilot in our EU footprint. We have two security-driven asks before procurement can complete: 1) customer-keystore residency in the EU (customer-managed KMS) for any tenant keys used for PII/pseudonymization, and 2) extended debug/audit log retention for 180 days (default in our assessment is 30/90 days and this is a hard requirement from our compliance team).

Concretely we need:
- A written confirmation that tenant keystore material can be kept under our KMS in eu-central-1 and that Redwood will not export keys to other regions.
- Evidence that debug and request-level telemetry for our tenant can be retained for 180 days with an auditable deletion path (we need sample CAIQ responses and any SOC 2 supporting artifacts that speak to log segregation and proof-of-delete).

I've attached a short requirements brief (novamed-retention-request.pdf). Can you confirm whether Private deployments can meet this, and what the path looks like (contracts, SOC2 excerpts, technical constraints)?

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Marta Vela
Head of Security Operations
Novamed

---
Attachment: novamed-retention-request.pdf (1 page PDF, high-level ask)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Vela <marta@novamed.eu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: EU keystore residency + 180d debug log retention

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear brief and the PDF. Looping in Marissa (Compliance) and Karthik (Legal) to help scope the evidence and contract changes. A few quick clarifying questions so we can give an actionable path: 

1) Is Novamed planning Redwood Private in your VPC (customer-managed infra) or Redwood Private hosted inside our EU tenant with customer-keystore integration? The integration steps differ.
2) For the 180d retention, do you need full request payloads or redacted/truncated debug traces? Any PII in those logs must be considered for additional controls.

High level answers we can provide now:
- Keystore residency: for Private deployments we can support customer-managed KMS in an EU region and prevent key export; we will need a keystore-integration runbook and a DPA addendum.
- Evidence: we can produce targeted CAIQ module responses and SOC 2 report excerpts that describe log segregation and deletion workflows, plus a summarized playbook for proof-of-delete.

Marissa/Karthik — can you confirm what artifacts we can deliver for a procurement pack (CAIQ/SIG pages, SOC2 excerpt, playbook) and whether we can accept a legal amendment to the DPA to enable 180d for this tenant?

Marta — I propose a short working call later today or tomorrow to align on the exact artifacts and whether we can agree an interim retention (e.g., 120 days) while we finalize the DPA change.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Senior Security & Privacy Manager
Redwood Inference

---
No attachments in this message.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Novamed ask — evidence and contractual path

Irene / Karthik / Soojin — quick internal assessment after reviewing Novamed's PDF: 

- Artifacts we can deliver quickly: a CAIQ module tailored to logging (we already have pre-filled SIG/CAIQ answers for retail deployments), an SOC 2 excerpt that discusses retention controls and log segregation, and a proof-of-delete playbook that explains our deletion APIs and deletion logs.
- Keystore residency: technically feasible for Private. We'll need an operational runbook for KMS binding + a rotation summary to show we don't export keys (attached draft).
- 180d retention: this is more than our standard offering for debug traces. Two options: 
   a) Contract amendment to allow 180d for Novamed tenant; must go to Legal and Sales (impacts SLAs/forensics behavior).
   b) Compensating controls to reduce exposure: pseudonymize tokens in debug traces, truncate request bodies, and keep full request metadata only. That would let us accept longer retention with lower risk.

Recommended next steps:
1) Offer interim 120d while Legal/Procurement completes DPA amendment.
2) Provide CAIQ/SIG logging module and SOC 2 excerpt within 48 hours.
3) Share technical runbook for KMS residency (attached) and schedule a 30-min technical sync with Novamed's SecOps.

Attaching: redwood-keystore-rotation-summary.pdf (2 pages — rotation + residency notes).

Marissa
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood-keystore-rotation-summary.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Vela <marta@novamed.eu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: EU keystore residency + 180d debug log retention

Hi Marta — following internal review, here is a proposed path that should be acceptable to Novamed and feasible operationally: 

1) Keystore residency: we can support customer-managed KMS in eu-central-1 for Private deployments. We'll deliver a technical runbook and the keystore rotation summary for your security team. No key material will be exported outside the bound region; we will include a short attestation in the procurement pack.

2) Retention: we can accommodate tenant-scoped 180-day retention for debug/audit traces via one of two routes: 
   - Preferred: DPA amendment + narrow-scope clause limiting full payload retention to pseudonymized traces and retaining only metadata for the full 180 days.
   - Interim: 120-day retention while Legal and Procurement finalize the amendment. During the interim we will provide weekly status and an evidence bundle (CAIQ logging module + SOC 2 excerpt + proof-of-delete playbook).

3) Evidence deliverables (we will send within 48 hours):
   - CAIQ/SIG logging module mapped to Novamed's asks
   - SOC 2 excerpt page(s) about logging and segregation
   - Proof-of-delete playbook and API example for deletion + audit record format
   - Keystore rotation/residency summary (attached)

If that sequence works, can we schedule a 30-minute technical sync tomorrow (Nov 3) at 09:00 CET to walk the runbook and confirm which payloads you require to be retained verbatim versus pseudonymized? Once agreed we will route a DPA addendum through Legal for signature.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call now if helpful.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Security & Privacy Manager
Redwood Inference
